items.title: MECH-357 SD-029 scheduled-external-hazard Stage-H: agent-relative discrete threat replaces 603s's undirected mobile-predator drift (successor of 603s)
items.note: SD-029 scheduled-external-hazard successor of V3-EXQ-603s per mech357_freeze_incompatible_pressure_scoping_2026-08-10.md. 603s's mobile-predator field (env_drift interval=1/prob=0.6) FAILED discrimination on an EXACT TIE (G_H_LESION_frac == G_H_INTACT_frac == 0.6667). The scoping spike traced this to env_drift being UNDIRECTED (_drift_hazards never targets the agent), which on a 10x10 grid with 4 fast hazards produces a spawn-position lottery rather than a graded conflict (603s's own per-seed data is strictly bimodal: 200-step ceiling or ~5.5-6-step self-contamination death). 603t replaces it with SD-029 scheduled_external_hazard (interval=20, prob=0.9, adjacent_only=True), an already-built, previously-unused CausalGridWorldV2 mechanism (causal_grid_world.py:260-270/4774-4843) that deterministically places a hazard adjacent to the agent's CURRENT position on a schedule -- agent-relative and discrete, removing the spawn-lottery confound. Threaded through scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py's Stage-H _build_env (new scaffold_hazard_stage_scheduled_external_hazard_* knobs, default-off/bit-identical -- empirically probed: 2 injections in 33 steps at interval=15, matches expected floor(33/15)). Ambient env_drift reverted to defaults (5, 0.3) so the discrete injection is the isolated new pressure variable. Same 3 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] + two-sided discriminative-headroom guard as 603s (unchanged -- it worked as designed there). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (G_H_LESION + INTACT-beats-LESION under SD-029 scheduled hazard) is a NEW manipulation absent from every recorded run -> not reanalysis-recoverable, ran fresh. Re-derive brake: count=1 for MECH-357 (603s only), below threshold=2 -> does not fire. Substrate-path overlap gate: no open corrupting substrate_queue entry overlaps scaffolded_sd054_onboarding.py or causal_grid_world.py. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, single seed, no crash); validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings, all 24 checks). Config commit: ree-v3 242fd7e74a. Prefer cloud (linux-x86_64).

items.title: MECH-303 contextual_safety_harm_threshold calibration battery: reachability/discrimination across num_hazards x harm_obs_a sourcing mode
items.note: Diagnostic follow-on to mech303_contextual_safety_threshold_reachability.md (2026-08-11): REEConfig.contextual_safety_harm_threshold defaults to 0.05 but agent.py sense()'s live gate (z_harm_a.norm() < threshold -> accumulate_safety) is unreachable at that default in every prior experiment that exercised it (V3-EXQ-520 overrode to 999; V3-EXQ-764 measured ~0.547 safe / ~0.542 unsafe, both ~11x above 0.05 and barely different). This battery sweeps num_hazards in {0,1,2,4,8} x 10 seeds x 150 ticks, live agent-path z_harm_a (not V3-EXQ-760's ground-truth proxy), across a candidate threshold sweep, reporting per-threshold reachability + AUC(safe-vs-unsafe). Step 2.5a empirical probe (this session) found a mechanistic reframe not anticipated by the original finding: SD-022 re-sources harm_obs_a from body-damage state when limb_damage_enabled=True (the production default every prior driver uses), decoupling z_harm_a from hazard proximity -- the pre-SD-022 legacy direct-proximity-EMA path (limb_damage_enabled=False) discriminates hazard density much better in a 1-seed probe (h0 0.559 vs h4/h8 ~0.72-0.73, vs damage-sourced's non-monotonic 0.547/0.524/0.440/0.380/0.429). So the battery crosses num_hazards x SOURCING_MODE (damage_sourced=production default, proximity_ema_sourced=legacy) as two independent load-bearing criteria (C1/C2, OR-gated overall PASS): C1 alone -> recommend a new default threshold via /implement-substrate; C2 only -> tension is sourcing-mode-specific, not a scalar default fix; neither -> structural SD-011 falsifier, routed to governance/claim-synthesis for the dual-nociceptive-split work. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (5-level battery x 2 sourcing modes x threshold sweep + AUC) is not recorded anywhere -- V3-EXQ-764 measured only 2 ad-hoc points via an inline probe with no manifest (764 itself is HELD, never queued); not recoverable, ran fresh. claim_ids=[SD-011] only (MECH-303 itself and its V3-EXQ-760 evidence are unaffected -- this is a downstream default-config usability question). experiment_purpose=diagnostic. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2 seeds x 20 ticks, all 20 cells clean, z_goal_stream correctly recorded as goal-off/unmeasured); validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings after adding ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT for the reachable-by-construction z_harm_a apparatus precondition).

items.title: SD-RESIDUE-VALENCE-BOUND validation: clamp/decay bounds the SD-014 valence accumulator (ON vs OFF)
items.note: Diagnostic validation of the SD-RESIDUE-VALENCE-BOUND fix landed this session (ree-v3 ree_core/residue/field.py + ree_core/utils/config.py; REE_assembly/docs/architecture/sd_residue_valence_bound.md). RBFLayer.update_valence() was an unclamped += with no decay, fired every step MECH-307 split-surprise crosses threshold, confirmed to affect all 6 SD-014 valence components (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-906a_894b_2026-08-09.md: z_world_norm ~150-320 vs ~0.5-0.7 smoke scale; failure_autopsy_906b-906c-911-cluster_2026-08-10.md: liking mean=19.88 vs 0.39 smoke ceiling, dread 40-110x rise). Fix: new no-op-default ResidueConfig knobs (valence_bounding_enabled=False, valence_decay_rate=0.02, valence_clamp_abs=5.0) threaded through a single shared helper so all 13 agent.py call sites + update_wanting_sensitized get the fix from one point; default OFF preserves bit-identical behaviour for the large body of historical experiments exercising this on-by-default path (valence_enabled=True), so no evidence-staleness audit is owed. Unit-level design (direct ResidueField/RBFLayer, no CausalGridWorld/REEAgent) since the fix is one central write path -- matches the V3-EXQ-520 Part-1 precedent. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (bounded-vs-unbounded accumulation under these new knobs) not recorded anywhere -- the knobs did not exist before this session; not recoverable, ran fresh. claim_ids=[] (no claims.yaml claim gates on this SD; all three motivating runs are claim_ids:[] diagnostics). experiment_purpose=diagnostic. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 1 seed x 6 conditions, OFF arm reproduces unbounded growth (200.0/395.5 after 200 writes), ON arm plateaus exactly at clamp_abs=5.0); validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings after adding ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT for the reachable-by-construction active_center_exists precondition).
